chunks: From him, from Isma'il ibn Sahl, from Hammad, from Hariz, from al-Fudayl, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

I said to him, 'For whom is the fitrah permissible?' He said, 'For the one who does not find [means]. And whoever it is permissible for, it is not obligatory upon him; and whoever it is obligatory upon, it is not permissible for him.'

key_terms.الْفِطْرَةُ: zakat al-fitrah, the alms due at the end of Ramadan
key_terms.لَا يَجِدُ: does not find means; lacking sufficient wealth or resources

ai.seo_question: Who is eligible to receive zakat al-fitrah, and who must pay it?
ai.summary: This hadith states the ruling that al-fitrah is for the one who lacks means. It also clarifies a reciprocal legal distinction: the one eligible to receive it is not obligated to pay it, and the one obligated to pay it is not eligible to receive it.
